The downshift blip is optional in the authentic baseline because the synchronized transmission can engage without driver rev matching; a heel-and-toe blip remains appropriate racing technique for smoother shifts and chassis stability. No exact 1974 RSR driver manual was recovered, so the value remains medium. AC refuses the shift without a blip, which stays a simulator override.
